name: negative front lever raise
description: An advanced hanging move where you lower slowly toward a front lever. It builds serious core and lat strength.
instructions: Hang from a bar and pull your body up so your hips and legs are above you.
Straighten your body and keep your arms locked.
Lower slowly toward a horizontal position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Stop when you cannot hold the line, then bend your knees to come back up.
Rest and repeat for a few careful reps.
